item.title: Kazuchika Okada defeats Hiroshi Tanahashi in main event of Wrestle Kingdom 20
item.description: AEW star Kazuchika Okada defeated Hiroshi Tanahashi in the main event of today’s Wrestle Kingdom 20, with Tanahashi taking a clean pinfall in his retirement match.
